package.description: The Trigno Wireless System Device Enabler allows the Trigno Wireless System to stream data directly into LabChart.

en-US.description: The Trigno Wireless System Device Enabler allows the Trigno Wireless System to stream data directly into LabChart.
en-US.longDescription: The Trigno Wireless System Device Enabler allows the Trigno Wireless System to stream data directly into LabChart. The Trigno Wireless device enabler and compatible Trigno Server software are available on the ADInstruments website. The Trigno Wireless System is manufactured by Delsys Inc. and allows the acquisition of EMG and related signals from subjects for biofeedback purposes, and is intended for relaxation training and muscle re-education.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Trigno Wireless
